timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,107.29 Cr (+23.3% YoY), net profit ₹189.65 Cr (+24.3% YoY).
eClerx Services Limited’s Board, led by VP & Company Secretary Pratik Bhanushali, recommended ₹1 dividend per ₹10 equity share for FY2026 on May 13, 2026, pending AGM approval.
eClerx Services Limited uploaded the earnings call recording for Q1 FY2027 on May 14, 2026, signed by VP-Legal & Company Secretary Pratik Bhanushali.
On 19 May 2026, eClerx Services filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on 14 May 2026.
Promoters Priyadarshan Mundhra, Anjan Malik, Umar Mundhra, Shweta Mundhra, Supriya Modi, and Pawan Malik declared no encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
eClerx reported Q1FY27 results with 23% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,152 Cr; EBITDA margin declined 260 bps QoQ to 23% due to wage hikes; new deal wins up 25% YoY to USD 41 million
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,188.66 Cr (+18.3% YoY), net profit ₹180.6 Cr (-1.6% YoY).
eClerx reported Q2FY27 consolidated total revenue of ₹1,212.6 crore (+17.1% YoY) and net profit of ₹180.4 crore.
2026-10-28: Board approved acquisition of 2% stake in Personiv Eclipse Inc. from subsidiary eClerx LLC for $1.64M
eClerx Services Limited uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call held on October 29, 2026, covering financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
